blocks.text: Edwin Hubble ne yeh dikha kar modern cosmology (kainat ke ilm) ki bunyaad rakhi ke galaxies zameen se door ja rahi hain, aur un ki velocity faasle ke saath barhti hai. Yani galaxy jitni door ho, utni hi tezi se door jati nazar aati hai. Is mushahide (observation) se Hubble's law bana, jo kehta hai:

blocks.title: Hubble's law
blocks.text: Galaxy ki recession velocity (door jane ki raftar) v zameen se us ke faasle d ke directly proportional (seedha mutanasib: faasla dugna to raftar dugni) hai.

blocks.title: Do you know? (Kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Hubble ki daryaft se pehle zyada tar scientists samajhte the ke kainat static (aik jaisi, na phailne wali) hai. Hubble's law ne yeh khayal ulat diya: kainat ki aik shuruaat thi, aur isi se Big Bang theory bani.
Yahan v recession velocity aur d faasla hai. Hₒ ko Hubble's constant kehte hain; is ki qeemat 2.3×10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ hai.

Fig. 21.6 Hubble's law ka graph hai. Is mein galaxies ka redshift (door jane ki velocity) aur zameen se un ka faasla seedhi lakeer (linear) ka talluq dikhate hain. Faasla barhe to recession velocity bhi barhti hai, jo phailti kainat ka mazboot saboot hai. Is seedhi lakeer ki dhalwan (slope) Hubble constant (H₀) hai, jo batata hai ke kainat kis sharah (rate) se phail rahi hai.

blocks.alt: Graph: khara mehwar Recession velocity, leta mehwar Distance. Bohat se nuqte origin se guzarti seedhi lakeer ke qareeb hain, beech mein ghane.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.6: Hubble ke qanoon ki graph ki shakal (kitab ki Figure 21.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Aik galaxy ham se bohat tezi se door ja rahi hai. Hubble's law ke mutabiq yeh us ke faasle ke bare mein kya batata hai?
blocks.explanation: Woh bohat door hai, kyunke v = Hₒd: zyada recession velocity ka matlab zyada faasla.

blocks.text: Kainat ki tamam galaxies aik doosre se door ja rahi hain. Kisi aur galaxy mein baitha observer bhi yahi dekhega. Yeh is liye ho raha hai ke khud space khinch (phail) rahi hai. Scientists Big Bang expansion samjhane ke liye aksar phoolte balloon (guhbare) ki misal dete hain (Fig. 21.7). Balloon ki surface par bane nuqte galaxies hain, aur balloon ki khaal (skin) ko kitab 'four dimensional space-time' kehti hai. Jab balloon phoolta hai to har nuqta baqi nuqton ko apne se door jata 'dekhta' hai, bilkul jaise galaxies space mein door hoti hain. Is model se do baatein samajh aati hain. Pehli: hum kainat mein kaheen bhi hon, galaxies ham se door jati nazar aayengi. Yani phailao har jagah ho raha hai aur koi khaas centre nahi; zameen kainat ka centre nahi. Doosri: kainat abhi phail rahi hai, to hum zehan mein waqt ko ulta chala sakte hain. Is ka matlab hai:

items: maazi (past) mein galaxies aik doosre ke zyada qareeb thin.
aur peeche jayen to saara maddah (matter) aik bohat chhoti, ghani aur garam halat mein daba hua tha.

blocks.alt: Teen gehre rang ke guhbare, chhote se bare; har aik par lakeerein aur wahi roshan nuqte usi jagah; bare guhbare par nuqte aik doosre se zyada door.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.7: phailti kainat ki misal: guhbara phoolne par nuqte door hote hain (kitab ki Figure 21.7 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Balloon ki misal mein do-dimensional khaal hamari teen-dimensional space ki jagah hai: nuqte khud balloon par nahi chalte, balke un ke darmiyan ki khaal phailti hai. Isi tarah galaxies ke darmiyan space barh rahi hai.

Yahi khayal Big Bang Theory ki bunyaad hai, jis ke mutabiq kainat taqreeban 13.8 billion (1380 crore) saal pehle aik ibtidai singularity (aik nuqte jaisi intehai ghani halat) se shuru hui aur tab se phail rahi hai. Hubble's law is baat ka mazboot mushahidati saboot hai ke kainat static nahi balke phail rahi hai, aur yeh Big Bang model ke aham sutoonon (pillars) mein se aik hai.
Big Bang se aaj tak kainat ke irtiqa (evolution) aur phailao ki taqreebi timeline Fig. 21.8 mein di gayi hai.

blocks.alt: Neeche Big Bang se oopar phailta makhroot (cone). Marahil aur waqt: Big Bang, 0; Recombination Era, 380 hazaar saal; First stars appear, 30 crore saal; Early galaxies, 1 arab saal; Modern galaxies (Acceleration), Today. Chhote labels: First structure formation; Expanding proto-clusters; Current Era: Lambda-CDM, aur kehkashaon ke door hone ke teer.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.8: Big Bang se aaj tak kainat ke irtiqa ki taqreebi timeline (kitab ki Figure 21.8 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Neeche se oopar waqt barhta hai aur cone ki chaurai kainat ka phailao dikhati hai. Pehle atoms (Recombination Era, 380 hazaar saal), phir pehle stars (30 crore saal), phir galaxies (1 arab saal), aur aaj taqreeban 13.8 arab saal baad phailao tez ho raha hai (Acceleration). Teer galaxies ke darmiyan barhte faasle dikhate hain.

blocks.prompt: Hₒ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹ le kar kainat ki umar 1/Hₒ se andaza lagayein.
blocks.explanation: 1/Hₒ = 1/(2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹) = 4.3 × 10¹⁷ s. Aik saal mein taqreeban 3.16 × 10⁷ s hain, is liye yeh taqreeban 1.4 × 10¹⁰ saal (14 arab saal) hai, jo maqbool qeemat 13.8 arab saal ke qareeb hai.

blocks.text: Satellite remote sensing aik taqatwar technology hai jis mein madar (orbit) mein ghoomte spacecraft par lage sensors space se zameen ke mahol ki nigrani aur tajziya (analysis) karte hain. Is se scientists jangalat ki katai (deforestation), climate change, samandar ka temperature aur hawa ki banawat (atmospheric composition) dekh sakte hain. Zameeni tareeqon ke muqable mein yeh bohat bara ilaqa aik saath dekhti hai aur baar baar mushahida karti hai, is liye lambe arse tak mahol ki nigrani mumkin hoti hai.

blocks.alt: Sooraj (Energy source) zameen (Target) par chamakta hai. Zameen se shuaein satellite (Sensor) tak jati hain, raaste mein aik nuqte par har taraf bikharti (scattering) hain. Satellite signals dish aur imaraton (Processing station) ko bhejta hai; mota teer data computer par baithe shakhs (Analysis) tak aur phir rangeen naqshe wale laptop (Application) tak le jata hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 21.9: remote sensing ka amal (kitab ki Figure 21.9 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Figure ki tarteeb neeche ke chhe qadamon jaisi hai: (1) Sooraj source hai, (2) raaste mein atmosphere radiation ko bikherti hai, (3) radiation zameen (target) se takrati hai, (4) satellite ka sensor lautne wali radiation record karta hai, (5) data processing station ko bheja jata hai, (6) phir analysis aur application.
Satellite remote sensing (SRS) ke qadam yeh hain:

items: Source and Illumination (source aur roshni): SRS ka pehla aur sab se aham hissa source hai jo target (jis cheez ko dekhna hai) ko roshan karta hai. Yeh electromagnetic radiation ki shakal mein hota hai (aam taur par Sooraj ki roshni).
Atmosphere: Source se nikalne ke baad radiation atmosphere se guzarti aur us se amal karti hai, maslan scattering (bikharna) ya reflection (mun'akis hona).
Interaction with Target (target se amal): Atmosphere ke baad radiation target se takrati hai; yeh amal target aur radiation dono ki khasiyaton par munhasir hai.
Recording with Sensor (sensor se record): Target se kharij ya mun'akis radiation sensors record karte hain jo door (remote) hain, yani target ko chhoote nahi.
Transmission and Reception (bhejna aur wusool): Sensor ka record kiya data receiving station ko bheja jata hai, jahan use tasaveer (images) jaisi samajh aane wali shakal mein badla jata hai.
Interpretation and Analysis (tashreeh aur tajziya): Tayyar tasveer se maloomat hasil karne ke liye us ki electronic ya digital tareeqe se tashreeh ki jati hai.
Hubble's law: v = Hₒd (21.5); Hₒ = 2.3 × 10⁻¹⁸ s⁻¹.
Balloon model: har jagah phailao, koi centre nahi; waqt ulta chalayen to sab aik garam, ghani halat mein.
Big Bang taqreeban 13.8 arab saal pehle; remote sensing ke chhe qadam.
